subject: [AMBER] Several postdoctoral positions available in EU

messages.author: Jan Brezovsky
messages.body:
Dear Amberites,
sincere apologies to those not interested.
We have some short-and longer-term post-doctoral positions in
biomolecular simulations and structural bioinformatics
(
https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/698936
<
https://t.co/Cn9Hdpsi2A?amp=1
>;
https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/jobs/615689
<
https://t.co/XLCfmdrWBw?amp=1
>). Come help us understand rare transport
processes in proteins! Thank you.
Best wishes,
Jan
--
